plugin.name: Canvas View
plugin.lastUpdateInfo: Full markdown rendering via showdown (tables, lists, images), notes open beside the canvas, caret-at-click editing, Obsidian-style card scrolling.
plugin.description: Edit Obsidian Canvas / JSON Canvas (.canvas) files inside NotePlan: create and connect cards, move, resize, color, label edges, undo/redo — fully compatible with Obsidian.
plugin.author: lifeplayer67

plugin.commands.name: open canvas
plugin.commands.description: Open a JSON Canvas (.canvas) file in a viewer window
arguments: path to the .canvas file (absolute, or relative to the canvas folder setting)

plugin.commands.name: new canvas
plugin.commands.description: Create a new empty JSON Canvas file and open it
arguments: name for the new .canvas file (a folder prefix is allowed, e.g. 'Projects/Ideas')

plugin.commands.name: onMessageFromHTMLView
plugin.commands.description: Canvas View: callback to receive messages from the HTML window

plugin.settings.title: Canvas folder
plugin.settings.description: Subfolder of your NotePlan Notes folder that holds your .canvas files (e.g. 'Canvases'). Relative paths given to the 'open canvas' command are resolved against it; absolute paths (starting with /) are used as-is.

plugin.settings.title: Open canvas in the main window (split view)
plugin.settings.description: When on, the canvas opens as a split pane inside the main NotePlan window (like a note). When off, it opens in a separate floating window.

plugin.settings.title: Open notes from cards in
plugin.settings.description: Where a note opens when you ⌘+click a card or press its ↗ button. 'Split view' keeps the canvas on screen.

plugin.settings.title: Log level
plugin.settings.description: Set how much logging output will be displayed when executing Canvas View commands in NotePlan Plugin Console.
